content.text: 29. INSTALL POWER STEERING PUMP ONTO BRACKET

items: (a) Install the PS pump and stay.
(b) Install the PS pump pulley with the drive belt.

content.text: 30. INSTALL COMPRESSOR WITH BRACKET ONTO BLOCK

items: (a) Install the compressor with the bracket onto the block.
(b) Turn the adjusting bolt on the idler pulley until the specified belt tension is obtained. (See page MA-4)
